OpenAI Academy Courses
Build the AI skills your organization needs
Practical courses for your organization, from using AI in everyday work to building solutions, and leading adoption.
About the courses
Learning is part of deployment
OpenAI Academy courses are shaped by teams across OpenAI, with practical examples and activities learners can apply to their own work. Every course includes an assessment, with official badges issued through Accredible. Courses are updated as our products and guidance evolve.

Start with the basics of AI, then learn to build repeatable workflows and direct work with agents.

Learn the basics of AI, large language models, and ChatGPT. You’ll practice giving clear instructions, adding useful context, reviewing outputs, and using AI responsibly in everyday work.

Build practical AI skills for work
OpenAI Academy courses help people build practical AI skills through hands-on learning. Together, the courses create a connected learning pathway designed to help people understand AI, apply it to real work, and turn successful approaches into repeatable ways of working.
Built by OpenAI, the courses bring together product guidance, research, safety expertise, and workplace practice to help learners build the skills and habits needed to work effectively with AI.
Why take these courses?
People build AI fluency by practicing on work that matters to them.
Developed with the teams building OpenAI's models and products, each course is built around real workplace tasks and hands-on activities. You'll practice giving clear instructions, adding relevant context, reviewing outputs, deciding what to delegate, and staying in control of the work.
Guide for deploying OpenAI Academy courses across your organization
Learn how to make courses broadly available, engage executive sponsors, and launch with coordinated organization-wide communications. The guide also includes practical steps for reinforcing participation, measuring available signals, and sharing outcomes.
